correctness.rationale: Abrams/Prue–Scrimshaw subdivision hypotheses hold for two particles: adjacent essential vertices have one edge and shortest nontrivial cycles have length 3. The finite cubical model has 15 vertices, 48 edges and 30 two-cells; connected one-skeleton gives rank ∂1=14. Independently reconstructed exact ∂2 over integers, verified specified 26×26 minor determinant −1 and four explicit independent null cycles with last four coordinates identity; hence rank ∂2=26 and Betti (1,8,4). For every one of 48 signed-permutation graph automorphisms independently computed signed cell action and induced action on four kernel cycles and verified chi_H1(g)=delta(g)*fixed_eight_sign_vectors(g) and chi_H2(g)=eta(g)+Σ_{sigma(i)=i}(−1)^flip_i. Semisimple rational characters give H1=delta⊗Q[{±1}³] and H2=W⊕eta. Character averages over all 48 and 24 rotations yield positive-degree invariant ranks (0,0) and (1,0). Exact finite certificate is exhaustive for this particular finite graph; no integral torsion or homotopy claim follows.
